# SciRooPlot

> SciRooPlot is a C++ and Python library on top of ROOT for defining, organizing and generating scientific plots: plots are declared in a small program, stored per project and drawn with the `plot` command line app.

Start with the agent skill: it is the condensed, agent-oriented description of the workflow, the API and the pitfalls. The README is the human walkthrough with commented examples.

## Agent skill

- [SKILL.md](https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/skill/scirooplot/SKILL.md): workflow, CLI, API essentials, drawing option aliases, modifiers, ratios, trees, C++ vs Python, pitfalls
- [API reference](https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/skill/scirooplot/reference/api.md): every setter of Plot, Pad, Axis, Data, Ratio, legends, texts, PlotManager, PanelLayout (generated from the headers)
- [Drawing options](https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/skill/scirooplot/reference/drawing-options.md): alias to ROOT option string for each data type
- [Command line](https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/skill/scirooplot/reference/cli.md): `srp` and `plot` commands, modes and configuration files

- [scirooplot.zip](https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/skill/scirooplot.zip): the skill folder as zip, ready to upload or unpack into a skills directory

## Documentation

- [README](https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/README.md): installation, usage and the commented example code
- [Advanced installation](https://scirooplot.github.io/SciRooPlot/ADVANCED_INSTALL.md): building ROOT and Boost from source
- [Headers](https://github.com/SciRooPlot/SciRooPlot/tree/master/include/SciRooPlot): Plot.h, PlotManager.h, PanelLayout.h — the authoritative interface
- [Example programs](https://github.com/SciRooPlot/SciRooPlot/tree/master/templates/example): DefinePlots.cpp and DefinePlots.py with example data
